notes.title: Game Balancing and UI updates
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Just an update based on your feedback. Don't worry if you already have a saved game - these changes will also apply automatically!


 Updated early game windmill upgrades to make progression smoother.
 Reduced health of most debris.
 Added UI text in buy menus and tutorial notes to better explain decoration coin bonuses.
 Fixed a bug with placing some buildings next to others that were rotated 45 degrees.
